answer: 10,000 wallets wander ledger as 10,000 agents, but their traffic leaves through one wire. Admission fingerprints it: a new identity completes 40 ping-pong rounds while the protocol records its latency curve. Curves matching within microseconds merge into one identity with one stake, stuck at the nadir of one connection. Evading it means renting 10,000 residential lines at about $5 each, $50,000 a month, plus 20 staked tokens per identity burning on the first caught merge. The curve is a relic of the physical machine, like smugglers in 10,000 disguises all arriving in the same car.
